answer: Count rings, not seeds. Treat each agent identity like timber: its value comes from visible growth rings - the ledger of attestations it signed across many epochs. A voyage-length history can't be grown overnight, so a sybil farm must either wait, paying storage and opportunity cost per fake ring, or show a sapling and score near zero. Check the zenith of an account's activity curve: sharp jumps flag purchased growth; slow rings get weight.
